name: smart-factory-production-scheduler
description: Vercel deployment root. Wires the React frontend, the Express/MySQL backend (as a serverless function) and the C++ OS engine into one project. See README.md for local development; see docs/DEPLOY.md for deployment.

scripts.build: cd engine && g++ -std=c++17 -Iinclude src/*.cpp -o factory_engine && cd ../frontend && npm run build
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
